xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5283: Flywheel page redesign: live lane board with plain-language blockers, action Needs-you cards, non-duplicative health strip, shipped-today timeline

plan.title: Flywheel page redesign: live lane board with plain-language blockers, action Needs-you cards, non-duplicative health strip, shipped-today timeline
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator directed this redesign to ship in this one issue (YOLO mode, 2026-11-14). The surface spans contracts, lib derivations, the status route, the CLI line, frontend components, one Playwright spec, screenshots and docs, but every slice serves one page and one payload; the DAG still fans out (wi2/wi3/wi4/wi6/wi7/wi11 parallel, then wi12-wi15 parallel).

narratives.Problem: The Flywheel Status tab is a thin table over the tick line: the header counts only tick ids (5) while showing every census row (7); live agents read 'no agent' because derive-status.ts drops Herdr 'done' panes (PAN-4666) and gate-queue waits are invisible; handoff conversations show '—'; text is cryptic ('#5127 · none · green', raw 'verification.failed'), titles truncate, the table scrolls sideways; Needs-you items are plain text.
narratives.Proposal: Extend the derived status (no stored state) with per-row stage, stageSince, owner, agent (including handoff conversations), plain-language blocker and cost, plus route-only health-strip and shipped-today fields; fix pane liveness through liveness.ts; replace the Status tab body with a vertical lane board (Plan, Build, Checks, Review, Merge, Deploy, Done today), Needs-you action cards, a health strip with only facts the global header lacks, and a shipped-today timeline; stack the page at phone width; guide the build with a committed-screenshot mockup and prove it with a Playwright spec. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-5283.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new endpoint, stored state, table, file or column, and no new frontend poll
- No change to the State, Report or Stats tabs, the rail cards above the tab, the header toggles, or the conversation column
- No restart-approval button in Needs-you
- No attribution of pan start calls to the launching conversation
- No merge-train ETA in minutes
- No per-check CI shard names
- No change to the tick-marker format or the /pan-flywheel skill
- No CLI rendering of the health strip or shipped-today
- No repetition of any global header item (agent count, GitHub quota, memory health, Needs-you count) in the health strip

autoDecisions.summary: Absorb the PAN-4666 liveness fix (Herdr 'done' panes count as live when liveness.ts confirms the agent) into this issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified live: agent-pan-5275 and conv-20261114-cc68 had agent_status 'done' and alive=true but liveAgents 0. The issue's acceptance 'never no agent' cannot pass without it.

autoDecisions.summary: Health strip and shipped-today are computed only by the route (src/lib/flywheel/health.ts) and memoized 30 s; pan flywheel status does not compute them.
autoDecisions.rationale: They need server facts (running build commit) and forge reads; the status endpoint is also polled every 30 s on every page by NeedsYouIndicator, so they must be cheap and cached.

autoDecisions.summary: Main CI verdict comes from a 60 s-memoized GitHub Actions read of the newest completed ci.yml push run, not from the read model.
autoDecisions.rationale: The read-model ciByProjectKey replaces the snapshot when a new head starts, so it cannot answer 'newest run that concluded'.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep deployed-vs-main in the health strip although StaleBuildChip sits in the global header.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists it explicitly, and StaleBuildChip's backend (/api/deploy/staleness → getDeployStaleness) returns null since PAN-3917, so the header never shows it.

autoDecisions.summary: Header count reads '<N> in flight · <M> shipped today' with N = inFlight.length; the '(loop)' wording is retired and the owner chip shows loop-driven cards.
autoDecisions.rationale: The acceptance demands the count equal the cards; counting only inTick rows is the reported bug.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs-you action buttons come only from structured row blockers (test-removal waiver, start issue, answer agent); free-text tick items get jump + link; no restart-approval button.
autoDecisions.rationale: Tick needs-you text is free text, so pattern-matching it into POSTs is unsafe; RestartApprovalBanner already owns restart approval globally.

autoDecisions.summary: No merge-train ETA in minutes; cards and strip say 'waiting for batch CI' or 'batching paused until HH:MM'.
autoDecisions.rationale: An ETA needs ready-since times from forge rollups the lib cannot read cheaply; inventing a time violates 'derive, don't guess'.

autoDecisions.summary: Owner rule: flywheel (inTick or flywheel: startedBy) > conversation (issue conversation row) > operator; planning-auto-handoff reads operator.
autoDecisions.rationale: startedBy carries no conversation name for a pan start from another conversation (verified agent-pan-5281: planning-auto-handoff), and docs/FLYWHEEL.md classifies that token as an operator origin.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate wait reason is recomputed at read time and waiters map to issues by issueId, then workspace/conversation-cwd prefix, then a feature-/hoff- regex.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified live: 9 waiter tickets, none with issueId, several in ~/Projects/hoff-pan-* handoff worktrees; tickets store no wait reason.

autoDecisions.summary: Lanes stack vertically in the rail and the page stacks rail above conversation below 768 px.
autoDecisions.rationale: The rail is 360-560 px and FlywheelPage's fixed split overflows a 390 px phone; the issue requires no horizontal scroll at both widths.

autoDecisions.summary: Screenshots (mockup and final) are committed under docs/screenshots/pan-5283/ and linked from the PR body; the mockup HTML stays in gitignored .tmp/.
autoDecisions.rationale: Precedent docs/screenshots/pan-4523 and pan-5239; .tmp/ is gitignored so PNGs need a tracked home for the PR.

autoDecisions.summary: No new frontend poll: all new data rides GET /api/flywheel/status, which the page already polls at 5 s.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue forbids new frontend polling and the page's only status channel today is that query.

autoDecisions.summary: Ship as one issue with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator directed 'ship the real implementation in this issue' in YOLO mode.
